biography_summary: 安东尼奥·C·蒙库帕 (Antonio C. Moncupa Jr.，业界昵称 Tony/ACM) 是菲律宾籍银行家，前东亚银行 (EastWest Bank, PSE: EW) 总裁兼首席执行官，执掌该行 16 年（2007 年 1 月至 2022 年 12 月 31 日），为该行成长为菲律宾主要全能银行的核心缔造者。他拥有德拉萨大学经济学与会计学双学位及芝加哥大学（布斯商学院）MBA；加入东亚银行前任 International Exchange Bank 执行副总裁兼首席财务官。任内标志性业绩包括：2012 年 5 月 7 日主导本行 PSE 上市并于同年 7 月获 BSP 全能银行牌照；2016 年完成对渣打银行菲律宾零售业务的收购交割；自 2012 年起将网点由 168 家（2011 年末）扩张近三倍，五年（FY2012-2016）总资源复合增速约 25%、2016 年末达 2920 亿比索，本行跻身消费信贷头部（汽车贷/个人贷前三大、信用卡发卡第六）。2017 年 5 月起升任副董事长仍兼 CEO，2022-07-01 交出总裁职务、2023-01-01 交出 CEO 职务（PSE 披露口径），卸任行政职务后留任副董事长至 2023 年年度股东大会退出董事会。2022-03 当选菲律宾银行家协会 (BAP) 主席兼总裁（任至 2023 年）。2023 年初结束 37 年银行生涯后转任 Vantage Equities、Vantage Financial 及 Philequity Management 独立董事至今。2017 年 3 月报道称其时年 58 岁（推算约 1958/1959 年生），确切出生日期未见公开披露。

quotes.title: EastWest 官网 News & Advisories（2022-06-08 上网）：'EastWest Announces Top Management Changes, Appoints First Female President'——'long-time Chief Executive Officer Antonio C. Moncupa Jr. steps down on December 31, 2022. Moncupa, who had been the Bank's CEO for the last 16 years, will remain as Vice Chairman of the Board.'；董事长 Jonathan Gotianun 致谢：'We thank Mr. Moncupa for his leadership that brought the Bank to where it is now. While we understand his desire to relinquish his executive role and give some time for his other interests, we look forward to continuously hear his insights in the board of directors.'

EastWest 官网 News & Advisories（2022-03-31）：'Antonio C. Moncupa is the new President of the Bankers Association of the Philippines'——BAP 年会（2022-03-28）当选主席、接替 PNB 总裁 Jose Arnulfo A. Veloso；当选引语：'Through the years, our agenda in the BAP is to seek better banking efficiency, through modernization that we now call digitalization, better fixed income, foreign exchange and derivatives markets, and safe and trustworthy banking.'

The Asian Banker（2017-03-31，转载 The Philippine Star）：'EastWest Bank appoints Jesus Roberto Reyes as president'——'Moncupa, 58, has steered EastWest Bank to one of the biggest banks in the country since taking over in January 2007. He has a double degree in Economics and Accounting from the De La Salle University and a Masters in Business Administration from the University of Chicago.'；'Before joining EastWest, he was executive vice president and CFO of the International Exchange Bank.'；Reyes 2017-05-01 出任总裁、Moncupa 仍任 CEO 并升任副董事长；五年复合增速 25%、2016 年末总资源 2920 亿比索；2017 年 BSP 行长人选热门之一

Philstar（Lawrence Agcaoili, 2022-05-27）：'EastWest Bank names new president, CEO'——Fernandez 任总裁（2022-07-01 生效）、Ngo 任 CEO（2023-01-01 生效）；'Moncupa, who has been the bank's CEO for the last 16 years, will remain as vice chairman of the board of directors.'；'Moncupa is also the president of the Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP).'
